statement: ∀ (J : Finset ℤ) (D : ℕ) (u v : ℤ → ℝ) (B : ℝ), 0 ≤ B → (∀ i ∈ J, |u i * v i| ≤ B) → |∑ i ∈ J, ∑ j ∈ J.filter (fun j => j ≠ i ∧ (j-i).natAbs ≤ D), u i * v i * (u j * v j)| ≤ (J.card:ℝ) * (2*(D:ℝ)) * B^2

plain_statement.en: New route · Signed factors and shift windows · FW-8008 · Bound the near-diagonal energy of a finite fiber

brief.zh: 固定 i 后注入长度 2D 的双侧非零移位集，再用绝对值和与权上界。全局预算还须乘上每类纤维的实际数量。
brief.en: For each i, inject the adjacent indices into the 2D nonzero offsets. Apply the absolute weight bound. The global budget also needs the number of fibers in each range.
